# DEMO_SPEC.md  (Owner: Unit B — Darshan)  [skeleton]

## Judge click-path (target)
1. Open app → NIO map. 2. Pick lat/lon + date. 3. See surface inputs (SST/SSS/SSH). 4. Reconstruct →
5. vertical temperature profile (+ uncertainty band). 6. Overlay nearest Argo + per-depth error. 7. Toggle anomaly.
8. Toggle observation-priority (top-K pins). 9. "Why this matters" panel.

## LIVE vs CACHED
UI must label each result. **Cached results are allowed ONLY if generated by the real model.** Never hardcode fake outputs.
